WebHeldDeliveries: Progress from this browser is held back. A request that deletes progress may still be running on the server at {0}, and progress sent now could be deleted with it. Only restarting that server ends it.
WebHeldRestartRequested: Progress is still held back. Restart the Audiobookshelf server at {0} now, then confirm here. This browser cannot tell whether the server restarted: if it did not, a delete still running there can remove progress sent after you confirm. Confirming covers only requests this browser had sent before you chose to restart; anything sent since stays held.
WebHeldRestartUnreadable: Progress from this browser is held back, and its record of the server restart it asked for cannot be read, so it cannot tell which requests a restart would end. Choose "Restart the server" again, then restart the Audiobookshelf server at {0} when asked.
